content.short: Sound Rig is a decentralized music platform on Cardano that empowers independent artists and music lovers.
content.description: Sound Rig is an innovative music marketplace designed to revolutionize how independent artists distribute and monetize their work on the Cardano blockchain. The platform allows creators to mint exclusive music NFTs, known as 'TUN3Z,' ensuring they receive fair compensation and maintain ownership of their digital assets. Sound Rig features a dual-token system with $STR3AM for utility and SIMBAdao for community governance. By bridging the gap between artists and fans through rewards and social impact initiatives, Sound Rig is defining the next generation of decentralized music streaming.
content.meta: Sound Rig is a decentralized Cardano music platform empowering artists with music NFTs and rewards. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
